operators.name: clover_means
operators.description: TRUE if text semantically matches a criterion (cross-encoder)

operators.name: clover_relevance
operators.description: Relevance score 0..1 of text to criterion

operators.name: clover_similar
operators.description: Embedding cosine similarity of two texts

operators.name: clover_sentiment
operators.description: Sentiment label + score for a text

operators.name: clover_pii
operators.description: PII detection preset (person, email, phone, ssn, ...)

pricing.note: a lane = one operation in flight

verified.note: one known-red NLI entailment case, tracked openly

managed.tagline: Batteries-included semantic ML for SQL — the models that passed our harness, hosted and versioned so your verdicts don't drift.

value_props.title: Tested
value_props.detail: Every operator vetted against a public battery; the model set is calibrated to agree with itself.

value_props.title: Fast
value_props.detail: GPU-batched inference, off your database — no CPU models stealing cycles from Postgres.

value_props.title: Stable
value_props.detail: Pinned model versions; verdicts don't move unless you choose to upgrade.

free_tier.note: Evaluate the full operator set on your own data — a single lane, no credit card. When a real workload outgrows one lane, add more.

highlights: 13 semantic operators: means, classify, sentiment, extract, PII, language, and more
Install is metadata only — nothing runs on your box
Every answer carries a receipt naming the exact model version that produced it
You could self-host this — the operators are open. This is the paved road.
privacy: Your data never leaves your database — operators send inputs, never tables
We never store your inputs or outputs — metering records counts, timings, and token totals only
Never used for training — your traffic trains nothing
The full audit trail lives in YOUR receipts, not ours
